title: selectBytes column-count cache
impact: Tried reusing exp 195's cached `json_name_tokens_col_count` so hot repeated `selectBytes()` calls skip one `sqlite3_column_count(stmt)` per execution. Rejected: the first two focused repeated-call pairs looked candidate-faster, but the warmed pair flipped the load-bearing 1-row and 10-row lanes candidate-slower while larger guards were flat. Prototype preserved at `archive/exp-206`; no runtime change kept.
